versionSelection.reason: CMR June 2024 pilot search has no Collection 3 matches; Collection 2 retained explicitly.

limitations: 70 m product grid cells retain mixed soil/vegetation signals and geolocation uncertainty; not isolated canopy temperature.
LST does not diagnose water stress. CWSI withheld: canopy temperature and wet/dry baselines are unavailable.
ETdaily is modeled daytime water transfer to the atmosphere, not irrigation demand or avoidable waste; sparse dates are not summed into monthly ET.
ESI is PT-JPL-SM actual/potential instantaneous ET (0–1), not a standardized drought anomaly. Low values prompt local review, not diagnosis.
ET ensemble spread is not total predictive uncertainty; LST pixel errors are not field-mean confidence intervals.
ET/ESI use ECOSTRESS LST, STARS vegetation and GEOS meteorology; comparison with Landsat, POWER or SMAP does not provide independent validation.

provenance.resampling: none; native COG window with exact UTM pixel/field intersections
